verdict.rationale: Superset lets developers send PR diff-line comments or Design-tool selections to a running/new agent session (superset-gh-1, superset-gh-2), which resembles delegating a bug/task with context, but this is diff/element-based, not a literal chat-thread @-mention workflow. A community comparison explicitly frames Superset as 'terminal-centric' rather than 'chat-centric' like a competing tool, suggesting the chat-thread paradigm isn't its core model. missing for 10: a documented chat-thread or comment-thread @-mention feature, evidence of threaded discussion before delegation, and confirmation this works outside PR/design contexts.
